# MistyMauve

MistyMauve is a muted mauve theme that blends Timberwolf and Bright Gray grays with warm Tulip tones. It carries dark and light color schemes and uses the Permanent Marker and Arvo fonts for a handwritten-meets-serif look.

![MistyMauve screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ravesplash/obsidian-misty-mauve/HEAD/dark.jpg)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "MistyMauve"
    author: "ravesplash"
    repo:   "ravesplash/obsidian-misty-mauve"
    slug:   "mistymauve"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/mistymauve"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/ravesplash/obsidian-misty-mauve"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ravesplash/obsidian-misty-mauve/HEAD/dark.jpg"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Style Obsidian with a muted mauve palette that blends gentle Timberwolf and Bright Gray grays with warm Tulip tones for a calm, chill workspace. Choose between dark and light color schemes and use Permanent Marker and Arvo fonts for a handwritten-meets-serif look."
}
```
